goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Corrected oxlint-tsrx's npm human/JSON location decoration to canonical Oxlint semantics without touching Rust or the native hot path. Undecorated native labels are grouped by file and unique UTF-8 byte offset, each source is read once, and every requested position is resolved in one forward byte scan with CR, LF, and CRLF handling. The converter preserves raw byte spans, matches official Oxlint controls after BMP/astral Unicode on prior and current lines, keeps ASCII unchanged, and fails closed on non-safe, out-of-range, or multibyte-splitting offsets. The separate Rust LSP UTF-16 mapping remains untouched and green. A new scenario-button site UX arrived concurrently after this runtime work and is intentionally delegated to T040 for scoped integration.
